title: hemocouple: physics-informed neural operators with exact flux projection for 1D-3D hemodynamic interface coupling (code, reference dataset and results)
description: Code, the 56-case OpenFOAM reference dataset of pulsatile flow through parametric axisymmetric stenoses, the final trained interface operator, and the coupled-evaluation results for the article 'Physics-informed neural operators with exact flux projection for 1D-3D hemodynamic interface coupling'. Code under the MIT license; dataset and results under CC BY 4.0.
